BillHeading.BriefDescription: Limiting the scope of cause for loss of aid.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to limiting the scope of cause for loss of aid; and amending RCW 28B.10.281.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 28B.10.281 and 1969 ex.s. c 222 s 3 are each amended to read as follows:Student loans—Certain activities may make student ineligible for aid.
BillSection.P: Any A student who organizes and/or participates, or both, in any demonstration, riot or other activity of which the effect is to that interferes with or disrupts the normal educational process at such the institution shall not be eligible for such aid of higher education in which the student is enrolled is not eligible for aid if:

P.TextRun: (1) The institution of higher education determines by formal finding that, in connection with the demonstration and in violation of the institution's code of conduct, the student engaged in or advocated for others to engage in:
(c) Other conduct intended to cause harm to persons; or
